result.summary: Found 1 visually broken issue: a failed restaurant image in the 'Popular right now' section. Other partially visible carousel and bottom content are intentional scroll indicators/viewport cutoff and were not flagged.

issues.description: The restaurant image for 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' in the 'Popular right now' section fails to load, showing a grey placeholder box with a broken-image icon instead of food/restaurant imagery, while other cards display images correctly.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image URL/asset for Tokumaru Ramen Bar, verify it returns a valid image, and add a proper fallback image with retry/error handling so a broken-image placeholder is never shown in production.
